concerns.text: LLM Backbone is set to `EleutherAI/pythia-410m` (410 M params) but Spec FR‑003 requires a lightweight 2.7 B model (e.g., Llama‑3‑2B‑int8). This violates the functional requirement and may affect reproducibility and computational budget.

Episode entity defines `leak_target` as a **boolean**, while the dataset contracts (`gatemem_episode.schema.yaml`) define `leak_target` as a **string**. This type mismatch will cause schema validation failures and breaks the data‑model ↔ contract alignment.

The plan never references the `output.schema.yaml` contract, yet the contract exists to validate the high‑level evaluation output. At least one plan task should generate output conforming to this schema (e.g., a final report step).
